login.title: Sign In
login.subtitle: Global panel
login.intro: Enter your email and password. New here? We'll create your account.
login.agree: By continuing you agree to our
login.failed: We could not sign you in. Please try again.

launch.title: Choose a business
launch.noHubs: Your account doesn't belong to any business yet. Ask whoever manages one to invite you.
launch.loadError: We could not load your businesses. Please try again.
launch.mfaUnavailable: Two-factor authentication is not available on this account yet.

invalidHub.title: Invalid sign-in link
invalidHub.heading: This sign-in link doesn't lead to a hub
invalidHub.message: The address it wanted to return to is not an ERPlora hub, so we stopped here. Open your hub and start the sign-in from its own screen.

notAMember.title: No access to this hub
notAMember.heading: You don't have access to this hub
notAMember.message: This account is not a member of {hub_host}. Ask whoever manages that hub to invite you, or sign in with the account that has access.

googleNoAccount.heading: No ERPlora account for this Google account
googleNoAccount.message: {account_email} has no ERPlora account. Ask whoever manages your business to invite you, or sign in with the account that has access.

authenticationError.heading: We could not sign you in with Google
authenticationError.message: Something went wrong while signing in with Google. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

loginCancelled.heading: Sign-in cancelled
loginCancelled.message: You cancelled signing in with Google. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
twoFactor.loadError: We could not load your security settings. Please try again.
twoFactor.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twoFactor.totpOnLead: You are asked for a code from your app after your password.
twoFactor.totpOffLead: Codes from an app such as Google Authenticator or 1Password, asked after your password.
twoFactor.recoveryUnused: {unused} unused — each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. | {unused} unused — each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator.
twoFactor.recoveryAllUsed: You have used all your recovery codes. Generate a new set now.
twoFactor.recoveryNoneLead: Without them, losing your authenticator locks you out of your account.

activate.title: Set up your authenticator app
activate.lead: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then type the number it shows.
activate.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key by hand:

deactivate.title: Turn off the authenticator app?
deactivate.lead: You will sign in with your password only.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.lead: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. Keep them somewhere safe.
codes.noneLeft: You have no codes left. Generate a new set now, before you need one.

regenerate.title: Generate new recovery codes?
regenerate.replaces: This replaces your {count} unused code. | This replaces your {count} unused codes.
regenerate.nothingLeft: You have no unused codes left, so nothing is thrown away.

reauthenticate.title: Confirm it's you
reauthenticate.subtitle: Account security
reauthenticate.passwordLead: Enter your password to change your sign-in security.
reauthenticate.codeLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
